author: Christoph Fischer (darktable.info)
name: DT Pro module groups
description: A module-group layout preset ('DT Pro') for darktable 5.4: organises the UI into Basics (AgX, Color Balance RGB, Contrast Equalizer, Color Calibration, Crop, Tone Equalizer, Exposure, ...) and Details groups, hides outdated modules, scene-referred workflow.
